e.title: GI Loss Reserving (BNM RBC)
e.summary: 车险已付三角形准备金分析 R 教学（BNM RBC 框架）：四法最佳估计+两种不确定性+Mack 检验+PRAD 75%
e.body: gi-loss-reserving 是车险已付理赔三角形的准备金分析 R 教学实现（马来西亚央行 BNM 风险资本框架语境）：四种最佳估计方法、两种准备金不确定性度量、Mack 模型形式假设检验，以及 75% 充足水平的逆偏差风险边际（PRAD）计提。对 RIAA：准备金分析的完整教学路线（最佳估计→不确定性→风险边际→偿付能力），RBC 语境下理解 PRAD。与 [[chainladder]]（方法库）、[[reserving-ensemble]]（UNSW）、[[insurance-scr-data]]（Solvency 语境）互补。关联 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[insurance-governance]]。

e.summary_en: R teaching analysis of a motor paid-claims triangle under the BNM RBC framework: four best-estimate methods + two uncertainty measures + Mack tests + 75% PRAD
e.summary_hk: 車險已付三角形準備金分析 R 教學（BNM RBC 框架）：四法最佳估計+兩種不確定性+Mack 檢驗+PRAD 75%
e.body_en: gi-loss-reserving is an R teaching implementation of reserving analysis on a motor paid-claims triangle (in the context of Bank Negara Malaysia's Risk-Based Capital framework): four best-estimate methods, two measures of reserve uncertainty, Mack's formal assumption tests, and a Provision of Risk Margin for Adverse Deviation (PRAD) at the 75% sufficiency level. For RIAA: a complete teaching path of reserving analysis (best estimate → uncertainty → risk margin → solvency), understanding PRAD in an RBC context. Complements [[chainladder]] (method library), [[reserving-ensemble]] (UNSW) and [[insurance-scr-data]] (Solvency context). Related: [[actuarial-pricing]], [[insurance-governance]].
e.body_hk: gi-loss-reserving 是車險已付理賠三角形的準備金分析 R 教學實現（馬來西亞央行 BNM 風險資本框架語境）：四種最佳估計方法、兩種準備金不確定性度量、Mack 模型形式假設檢驗，以及 75% 充足水平的逆偏差風險邊際（PRAD）計提。對 RIAA：準備金分析的完整教學路線（最佳估計→不確定性→風險邊際→償付能力），RBC 語境下理解 PRAD。與 [[chainladder]]（方法庫）、[[reserving-ensemble]]（UNSW）、[[insurance-scr-data]]（Solvency 語境）互補。關聯 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[insurance-governance]]。
